basic_info.description: Built-around a lovely and mature common garden area, this house-like condo is part of a 2-unit complex of bungalow like homes. Located in Potrero Hill, this home feels like an oasis in the heart of everything. This 1 bedroom and 1 bath home features an updated chef's kitchen with stainless appliances and beautiful cabinetry that is open to the large living / dining room. Off of the living room is the light-filled private deck area, and the common garden. Shared garden area creates sense of light and openness. Walk-in closet in the bedroom as well as oversized and updated bathroom with windows to patio. 1-car garage parking and in-unit washer dryer. Easy access to 280 & 101 as well as Whole Foods, restaurants and shops of Potrero Hill and Dogpatch.
